solutions.check: grid rebuilt from the blog's light list (unique); every answer written into it with each crossing agreeing

clue.text: Bend that may be seen in locks

definitions.meaning: a very tight turn in a mountain road, named after the U-shaped clip

definitions.text: that may be seen in locks
definitions.meaning: a U-shaped pin used to hold a woman's tresses in place

explanation.definitionFit: The same word names a sharp U-turn on a road and the clip that holds hair in place.

clue.text: Amount of muck one found in ghastly loch

indicators.note: the single letter is found sitting inside the two-part word built around it

parts.note: ghastly means grim
Loch Ness is the famous Scottish loch
one is the Roman numeral I

explanation.surface: Someone measures the filth discovered in a horrible Scottish lake.
explanation.definitionFit: Griminess is the quality or extent of dirt, so it measures how much muck there is.

clue.text: Photos of work aboard ship

indicators.note: being aboard a vessel means being inside it, so one piece goes within the other

parts.note: SS stands for steamship
to till is to work the soil

explanation.surface: Pictures taken of someone labouring on a vessel.
explanation.definitionFit: Stills are single photographs, especially frames taken from or for a film.

clue.text: The cream to play against Wolves

parts.note: to face a team is to play against it
a group of wolves is a pack

explanation.surface: A football side's top players are lining up to take on Wolverhampton Wanderers, the club nicknamed Wolves.
explanation.walkthrough: The surface reads 'The cream' as a team's best players and Wolves as the football club; in fact the cream is a beauty product.
explanation.definitionFit: A face pack is a cosmetic cream spread on the face and left to set.

clue.text: Getting established — it can be harder for someone with a big corporation

definitions.meaning: settling into a new role or place with growing confidence

definitions.text: it can be harder for someone with a big corporation
definitions.meaning: corporation is old slang for a paunch, and a big belly makes locating one's toes harder

explanation.definitionFit: The idiom means becoming settled and confident; literally it means locating your own lower extremities.

clue.text: Worrying about the heartless activity at event

indicators.note: the outer word goes about, around, the trimmed piece

parts.note: caring, being concerned, is taken as worrying

indicators.note: heartless means the middle letter of the word is removed

explanation.surface: Someone fretting over a pointless pastime at some function.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Worrying' looks like an adjective describing the activity, but it is a verb meaning fretting, here caring.
explanation.definitionFit: Catering is the business of supplying food and drink, the activity laid on at a function.

clue.text: What mountaineer requires is hint when ascending — to get on

indicators.note: in a down clue, ascending means the word is read from bottom to top

parts.note: a tip is a hint
taken as written

explanation.surface: A climber needs a suggestion while going up so as to make progress.
explanation.definitionFit: A piton is a metal spike driven into rock to support a climber's rope.

clue.text: Men having beer after church — where this is sung?

indicators.note: the men-and-beer pair is placed after the church abbreviation
the men piece has the beer piece attached

parts.note: OR, other ranks, means soldiers who are not officers
ale is a kind of beer

explanation.surface: Soldiers drink beer after the church service.
explanation.walkthrough: The definition is a cryptic pointer: the answer is the very thing sung in church.
explanation.definitionFit: A chorale is a stately hymn tune, the kind of music sung in church.

clue.text: Duck beyond river grabbed by some other bird

indicators.note: the river-and-duck pair is grabbed and held inside the word for some

parts.note: part means some of something

indicators.note: the duck piece comes beyond, after, the river piece

parts.note: a duck in cricket is a score of nothing, O

explanation.surface: A duck past the river is seized by another kind of bird.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Duck' seems to be a bird alongside the other one, but it is the zero score O.
explanation.definitionFit: A parrot is a bird, and 'other' marks it as distinct from the duck in the surface.

clue.text: Symbols in old books stored in country

indicators.note: the books are stored inside the country word

parts.note: a nation is a country
OT is the Old Testament, the old books of the Bible

explanation.surface: Signs in ancient volumes kept in a national archive.
explanation.definitionFit: A notation is a system of written signs, as in musical or mathematical symbols.

clue.text: Conservative getting found out fell apart

parts.note: rumbled means found out or discovered

explanation.surface: A Tory politician is exposed and collapses.
explanation.definitionFit: To crumble is to break into small pieces, so crumbled means disintegrated.

clue.text: Payment covered by parent always

indicators.note: the letters are covered by the words around them, sitting inside them

explanation.surface: A parent is always the one who pays.
explanation.definitionFit: A rental is the sum paid to hire or rent something.

clue.text: One in sheltered accommodation's in Chinese city

indicators.note: the single letter goes in the word for canvas shelters

parts.note: tents are sheltered accommodation, with the 's giving S
one is the Roman numeral I
taken as written

explanation.surface: A resident of a care home is in a city in China.
explanation.walkthrough: 'sheltered accommodation' suggests a care home for the elderly; here it is tents. TIENTSIN is the older spelling of Tianjin.
explanation.definitionFit: Tientsin, now usually spelt Tianjin, is a major port city in northern China.

clue.text: Joker concealing name is a criminal

indicators.note: the joker word conceals the letter inside itself

parts.note: a gagster is someone who tells jokes

explanation.surface: A comedian hiding his identity is really a crook.
explanation.definitionFit: A gangster is a member of a gang of violent criminals.

clue.text: Animals brought up and graded in different cages?

indicators.note: in a down clue, brought up means the word is reversed upwards

parts.note: apes are animals
rated means graded

explanation.surface: Zoo animals are reared and then ranked, perhaps each in its own enclosure.
explanation.definitionFit: Animals kept in different cages are separated, held apart from each other.

clue.text: One sent before time, left to go to collect girl

indicators.note: the shortened word collects the girl inside it
the letter for left has to go from the word

parts.note: early means before the expected time
a miss is a girl

explanation.surface: A messenger dispatched ahead of schedule departs to pick up a young woman.
explanation.walkthrough: 'left to go' removes L from EARLY, giving EARY, which then collects MISS.
explanation.definitionFit: An emissary is an envoy, someone dispatched on a mission.

clue.text: Urge fellow to be a correspondent?

parts.note: to press someone is to urge them
a man is a fellow

explanation.surface: Someone presses a chap to write for the paper.
explanation.definitionFit: A pressman is a journalist, and a correspondent reports for a newspaper; the question mark marks a loose example.

clue.text: Recover as result of fantastic miracle

indicators.note: fantastic suggests something wild and unreal, so the letters are wildly rearranged

explanation.surface: Getting something back thanks to an amazing wonder.
explanation.definitionFit: To reclaim is to get back something lost or taken.

clue.text: Out on the field, puzzled?

definitions.meaning: in cricket a batsman is dismissed when the wicketkeeper breaks the wicket while he is out of his ground
baffled, at a loss for an answer

explanation.definitionFit: In cricket this is a way of being dismissed; generally it means baffled by a question.

clue.text: Removes portions of text

definitions.meaning: passages taken from a book or document

explanation.definitionFit: As a verb it means pulls out; as a plural noun it means passages quoted from a book.

clue.text: Bird that is half hidden sitting on water plant

indicators.note: in a down clue the first piece sits on top of the second
half of the word is hidden, leaving only its first two letters showing

parts.note: a rush is a plant growing by water

explanation.surface: A bird partly concealed perches on a reed in the marsh.
explanation.definitionFit: The thrush is a common songbird, such as the song thrush or mistle thrush.

clue.text: Cards shown round front of club to get such initially?

definitions.text: Cards shown round front of club to get such initially?

indicators.note: the cards go round the club's first letter

parts.note: aces are playing cards

indicators.note: front of means just the first letter of the word
initially means the first letter of the word

explanation.surface: Membership cards are flashed at the club door to be let in.
explanation.walkthrough: 'round' puts C inside ACES, and 'initially' adds S; the whole clue also describes cards shown to gain entry to a club.
explanation.definitionFit: Access is the right or means of entry, which a membership card shown at the door provides.

clue.text: Be established as transporter of football team?

indicators.note: a transporter carries something inside it, so one piece holds the other

parts.note: a football side has eleven players, XI in Roman numerals

explanation.surface: Does a team bus count as established?
explanation.definitionFit: To be and to exist are synonyms, both meaning to have being.

clue.text: Rural communities full of anger — they can kill people

indicators.note: the farms word is full of, holding, the anger word

parts.note: farms make up rural communities
ire is anger

explanation.surface: Furious country folk who might turn murderous.
explanation.definitionFit: Firearms are guns, weapons capable of killing.

clue.text: Josh revealed as wicked in time

parts.note: bad means wicked
taken as written
an age is a period of time

explanation.surface: Someone named Josh turns out to be evil before long.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Josh' looks like a man's name; it is the verb or noun meaning teasing banter.
explanation.definitionFit: To josh is to tease good-humouredly, and badinage is playful teasing talk.

clue.text: Man in street unruffled

parts.note: even means calm and unruffled

explanation.surface: A fellow out on the road stays calm.
explanation.definitionFit: Steven is a man's first name, so it stands for a man.

clue.text: Thy meat's going off — it's purple!

indicators.note: meat going off is spoiling, so the letters are spoiled into a new order

explanation.surface: Your meat has gone rotten and turned purple.
explanation.definitionFit: Amethyst is a violet variety of quartz, and the name of its colour.
